cases.name: Tenet Arca Plasmor
referenceLimitations: the projectile is a WALL 4.4 metres thick, which with the infinite body punch through above is most of what this weapon is in a room: one shot sweeps everything in a 4.4 m band. This arena fires a RAY, so only the bodies on the line are struck and the width buys nothing
shots BOUNCE off surfaces up to 4 times, which the page's own tips call worth doubling a shot's hit count when aimed off a wall behind the target — there are no surfaces here

the guaranteed Impact proc is capped at 29 metres ("Shots have a guaranteed Impact proc to enemies up to 29 meters") and is applied at every distance here, since a forced proc carries no range of its own. It overstates the shot only past 29 m, where the damage is already at its falloff floor
the innate punch through does not apply to SURFACES when the central portion of the projectile hits one — a geometry rule in an arena with no geometry

cases.name: Fulmin Prime
referenceLimitations: switching modes takes ONE SECOND of animation (0.5 s on Wisp) and this sim never switches — each mode is measured as if it were the whole weapon

the guaranteed Impact proc only reaches enemies within 9 metres, and the distance scales with Projectile Speed (wiki) — this entry applies it at every range, so a shot fired further out is overstated by one forced proc
this weapon is SILENT and this arena has nobody to alert — stealth is worth nothing here and a great deal in a real mission

triggerSeries.label: 主要·死首
triggerSeries.conditionText: 头部弱点命中造成击杀时触发。

cases.name: Tenet Cycron
referenceLimitations: corpses keep conducting the chain, which the page states as 'Enemy corpses will still allow the beam to connect to nearby enemies' — this arena removes a body when it dies

Ruinous Extension's reach — the page states the beam is 'extendable to 36 meters', and beam-range mods are shown on the card without being applied until a measurement settles the flat-versus-percent bracket (docs/UNMODELLED.md)

cases.name: Aksomati Prime
referenceLimitations: the AUTO-SPOOL ramp is not modelled — the page gives this trigger as Auto-Spool and the fire rate here is the spooled-up 13.33/s from the first shot, so a short burst is faster in this sim than in game
the ACCURACY improves during the spool as well (wiki), which is the half of it the page does state — this entry carries the settled cone, so a burst that would open wide here opens tight

triggerSeries.label: 霰弹·仇杀
triggerSeries.conditionText: 击杀距离不超过 5 米的目标时触发。

cases.name: Kompressa
referenceLimitations: the bubbles explode 0.6-0.8 SECONDS after they land, which the page says 'may allow enemies to move out of the explosion range if not directly hit' — this engine resolves the blast at the point of impact immediately, so nothing ever escapes one here
the blast needs no line of sight and goes through walls — this arena has no geometry, so nothing is ever behind cover and the perk pays nothing extra
the blast staggers the WIELDER in game — this arena gives the player no body, so a build that would be unplayable in a corridor costs nothing here

cases.name: Quanta Vandal
referenceLimitations: THE CUBE'S OTHER EXPLOSION, which is four times this one: a cube damaged by a player goes off in a 6 metre radius for 600 Blast. It is a two-step play — place a cube, then shoot it — and this arena fires one attack at one aim point, so the step that pays is the one it cannot take
a cube left alone detonates after 9 seconds, which needs a miss and a clock this arena does not run
the blast needs no line of sight and goes through walls — this arena has no geometry, so nothing is ever behind cover and the perk pays nothing extra

cases.name: Tenet Quanta
referenceLimitations: THE CUBE'S OTHER EXPLOSION, which is four times this one: "If damaged by any player (e.g. nearby cube explosion), cube explodes in 6 meter radius" for 600 Blast. It is a two-step play — place a cube, then shoot it — and this arena fires one attack at one aim point, so the step that pays is the one it cannot take
a cube left alone detonates after 9 seconds, which needs a miss and a clock this arena does not run
the blast needs no line of sight and goes through walls — this arena has no geometry, so nothing is ever behind cover and the perk pays nothing extra
this weapon does NOT inflict self-stagger, which is a real advantage over every other explosive in this batch and is worth nothing here, because the arena never charges any of them for it either

cases.name: Ogris
referenceLimitations: 'Enemies can destroy the rockets with gunfire or area of effect explosions' (wiki) — nothing shoots back in this arena, so every rocket reaches what it was aimed at

the launcher-exclusive Adhesive Blast is outside the pools this roster loads — it sticks the rocket to what it hits, which changes where the explosion goes off and is a placement this arena has no room to be wrong about
the blast needs no line of sight and goes through walls — this arena has no geometry, so nothing is ever behind cover and the perk pays nothing extra
the blast staggers the WIELDER in game — this arena gives the player no body, so a build that would be unplayable in a corridor costs nothing here
